page.title: Settings
page.description: The essentials first. Everything else waits under Advanced settings.
page.instantSave: These sections save as soon as you change them.

actions.unsafeWebhookUrl: This webhook URL is not allowed
actions.invalidBookingUrl: Invalid booking link: it must start with https://

pilot.title: Autopilot
pilot.descriptionAi: Clozer reads every prospect like a seasoned closer: who reads what, what's blocking, when to follow up. It drafts the follow-ups on its own.
pilot.descriptionNoAi: Follow-ups are drafted from simple rules until an AI is configured.
pilot.hint: Either way: at most 3 follow-ups per contact per month, never right after a read, always during the prospect's business hours, and never a hint that you can see what they read.
pilot.question: When Clozer has drafted a follow-up
pilot.copilotHint: Recommended to start. You get an email, and the follow-up waits for you on the dashboard ("Follow-ups to approve") and on the prospect's page, under Follow-ups.
pilot.autopilot: It goes out on its own when Clozer is confident
pilot.autopilotHint: Tricky cases (an objection, a message from the prospect, any doubt) still wait for your approval. You get a recap every morning.

alerts.title: Notifications
alerts.description: Only when it's worth it: a prospect who replies, a good moment to call, and a recap every morning. These settings only apply to you.
alerts.actionsHint: Approval, change request or meeting booked: it's rare, and the prospect is waiting on you.
alerts.actionsLabel: An email as soon as a prospect approves, asks for a change or books a meeting
alerts.callConnected: {which, select, both {Chrome and Outlook connected.} chrome {Chrome connected.} other {Outlook connected.}} You get an alert when a prospect opens your proposal for the first time, comes back after a silence, lingers on pricing or reads it with others. Never in the evening or on weekends, 4 per hour at most.
alerts.callNothingConnected: Nothing connected: install Chrome or Outlook below (Advanced settings) to get notified while they read.
alerts.callExtension: Notification in Chrome, alert in the Outlook pane
alerts.digestHint: Who to reach out to today and why, then yesterday's replies and reads. Monday to Friday, nothing if there's nothing to say.
alerts.teamChannels: For the whole team, also notify on
alerts.connectSummary: Connect Slack or an external tool
alerts.slackConfiguredPlaceholder: Already connected, leave empty to keep it
alerts.webhookSigned: Every request is signed (HMAC SHA-256, X-Closing-Signature header) with the secret
alerts.smartLink: Smart Link: reader.opened fires as soon as a prospect who came from a cold email starts reading, with their email. In Zapier or Make, hook it to Lemlist's or Instantly's "pause lead". reader.hot follows when they cross the hot threshold.

agenda.title: Your calendar
agenda.description: Your booking page: prospects book a slot straight from your links. This setting only applies to you.
agenda.label: Booking link
agenda.hint: Calendly and Cal.com open inside the prospect's page, with their name and email already filled in. HubSpot, Google Calendar, Microsoft Bookings and the rest open in a new tab. Empty: no "Book a meeting" button.

offer.title: Your offer
offer.descriptionInferred: Prefilled by Clozer from "{document}". Fix what needs fixing and save: your follow-ups will only get sharper.
offer.description: Optional. With nothing here, Clozer relies on your documents; it prefills this part when it reads the first one.
offer.whatPlaceholder: Shopify e-commerce site redesigns, from audit to launch, in 8 to 12 weeks.
offer.customersPlaceholder: DTC brands with $2M to $20M in revenue, decided by the founder or the head of e-commerce
offer.whyPlaceholder: Flat-rate pricing, +18% conversion rate on average, a dedicated team
offer.objectionsPlaceholder: Too expensive compared to a freelancer, afraid of losing SEO, not the right time

links.title: Your links
links.description: What every new link offers by default. Clozer adapts it to the document (the countdown only applies to quotes and proposals), and you can change it all link by link.
links.expiryHint: After that date, the prospect sees the document locked and can ask you for an extension.
links.expiryLabel: A quote or proposal expires after
links.voiceComments: Let the prospect record a voice note on a page

assistant.title: Prospect assistant
assistant.descriptionAi: On your documents, it answers the prospect's questions when you're not around. It relies on the document and on what you write here, never on a made-up price or term. Whatever it doesn't know, it passes on to you right away.
assistant.descriptionNoAi: No AI is configured: the assistant stays hidden for now.
assistant.enableHint: You can change it link by link later.
assistant.enableLabel: Turn on the assistant for new links
assistant.knowledgePlaceholder:
Payment: 30% upfront, the balance on delivery.
Warranty: 12 months, email support within 1 business day.
Our stack: Shopify, Klaviyo. No native mobile development.
assistant.knowledgeHint: Applies to all your documents: terms, warranties, support, FAQs, technical details. The prospect can get any of it just by asking: nothing confidential here.

messages.title: Your messages
messages.description: Follow-ups are written in your name: how you sign, and in what tone.

privacy.title: Data and privacy
privacy.description: Read tracking is erased 12 months after a link's last activity. A deleted document is gone for good after 30 days.
privacy.eraseDescription: Reads, messages, voice comments and follow-ups tied to this address are gone for good.
privacy.eraseSignaturesKept: {count, plural, one {The signed approval stays} other {The # signed approvals stay}}: it's the proof of agreement, kept for 5 years.
privacy.requestDescription: A prospect wants to know what you have on them, or to be forgotten? Look up their email, send them the export or delete everything. Reply within a month.
privacy.lookupCounts: {links, plural, one {# link} other {# links}}, {views, plural, one {# read} other {# reads}}
privacy.exportWorkspaceDescription: Links, prospects, reads and messages, as JSON.
privacy.deleteAccountDescription: Your prospects stay in the workspace, your access goes away.
privacy.deleteAccountDialogDescription: You'll be signed out everywhere. Your links stay with the team.
privacy.deleteWorkspaceDescription: Documents, links, prospects, files and team. Can't be undone.
privacy.deleteWorkspaceDialogDescription: Everything is erased, files included, for the whole team. Export first if needed.

privacyActions.nothingToErase: Nothing to delete for this address.
privacyActions.ownerOnly: Only an owner can delete the workspace.
privacyActions.typeWorkspaceName: Type the exact workspace name to confirm.
privacyActions.soleMember: You're the only one in "{workspace}": delete the workspace instead.
privacyActions.lastOwner: Make someone else an owner of "{workspace}" before you leave.

extensionTokens.revokeDescription: Chrome or Outlook will need to be reconnected.
extensionTokens.title: Chrome and Outlook
extensionTokens.description: Attach a PDF in your inbox, Clozer swaps it for a link and lets you know while it's being read.
extensionTokens.chromeHint: Gmail and Outlook on the web.
extensionTokens.chromeSoon: Coming soon to the Chrome Web Store.
extensionTokens.outlookStep2: Outlook › Add-ins › My add-ins › Add a custom add-in › Add from file.
extensionTokens.outlookStep3: In a new email, click Clozer, then "Connect Clozer".
extensionTokens.outlookAdmin: Your IT team can also deploy it for the whole team from the Microsoft 365 admin center.

extensionConnect.noNonce: Open the Clozer extension in Chrome and click "Connect Clozer" to get here.
extensionConnect.doneHint: Head back to Gmail or Outlook: attach a PDF, the link happens on its own. You can close this tab.
extensionConnect.account: The extension will create links in the {workspace} workspace, on behalf of {email}.
extensionConnect.missing: Clozer can't find the extension in this browser. <link>Install it from the Chrome Web Store</link>, then click its "Connect Clozer" button.
extensionConnect.expired: This connect page has expired, the extension probably updated in the meantime.
extensionConnect.restarted: A new tab just opened, carry on there.
extensionConnect.notificationMissed: I didn't see the "Clozer is ready" notification
extensionConnect.notificationBlocked: Your computer is probably blocking Chrome's notifications. Two clicks to allow them:
extensionConnect.macAllow: Pick Google Chrome, turn on "Allow notifications".
extensionConnect.windowsAllow: Turn on notifications for Google Chrome.
extensionConnect.meanwhile: In the meantime, alerts show up in a banner at the top of Gmail or Outlook, and you also get them by email (change it in Settings › Notifications).
extensionConnect.resent: Sent again, do you see it?

outlookConnect.doneHint: Head back to Outlook. Attach a PDF to an email: Clozer swaps it for a link right away. You can close this tab.
outlookConnect.account: Outlook will create links in the {workspace} workspace, on behalf of {email}.
outlookConnect.codeHint: The code shows up in the Clozer pane in your Outlook. Never enter a code someone else sent you.

mailbox.title: Mailbox
mailbox.description: Your campaigns go out from your own mailbox. Clozer reads your replies to stop sequences.

probe.instruction: Send any email from this mailbox to this address, then click Refresh.

spf.missing: No SPF record found for your domain. Add one so receivers trust your messages.
spf.duplicate: Your domain has two SPF records, which breaks the check. Merge them into one.
spf.missing_provider: Your SPF record does not include your mail provider. Add it.

dkim.unknown: We could not find a DKIM key. It may use a selector we did not try. Check with your provider.
dkim.revoked: The DKIM key is revoked. Publish a new one with your provider.

dmarc.missing: No DMARC record found. Add one, even with a soft policy.
dmarc.none_policy: Your DMARC policy is set to none. It works, but it protects little.

mailbox.ramping: new mailbox, the limit rises over three weeks
mailbox.disconnectDescription: Campaigns using it will stop sending. Your password is erased from Clozer.
mailbox.googleNotice: Gmail and Microsoft 365 will get a dedicated connection (coming soon). Meanwhile, Gmail accepts an app password.
mailbox.microsoftNotice: Microsoft 365 is not available yet. The form is disabled for now.
mailbox.appPasswordHint: Use an app password, not your usual Google password.
mailbox.secureHelp: Tick direct SSL/TLS only for ports 465 (SMTP) and 993 (IMAP). Otherwise the connection must support STARTTLS (ports 587 / 143).

form.userDiffers: Emails will go out as {email}. Make sure this account is allowed to send for that address.

lastError.AUTH_REVOKED: The server refused the credentials. Reconnect the mailbox with a valid password.
lastError.QUOTA: The provider's sending quota is reached.
lastError.TRANSIENT: The mail servers could not be reached.
lastError.CONFIG: The mailbox setup is invalid. Check the servers and ports.
lastError.POLICY: Too many bounces: sending was paused to protect your reputation.

errors.invalid: Check the fields: email, servers, ports and password are required.
errors.exists: This mailbox is already connected in your workspace.
errors.limit: You reached the maximum number of mailboxes.
errors.tooMany: Too many connection attempts. Try again in an hour.
errors.AUTH_REVOKED: The server refused these credentials. Check the username and password.
errors.QUOTA: The provider says the sending quota is reached. Try again later.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts on the provider side. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.TRANSIENT: Could not reach the mail servers. Check the hosts and ports, then try again.
errors.CONFIG: This setup is not supported. Check the servers and ports.
